# ideadump

> A place to dump ideas: capture them in your own words, research them a little, index and relate them, and find them again


## Pages in this subsection

- [ideadump](ideadump.html.md): ideadump: a place to dump ideas, research them a little, and find them again.
- [ideadump.base](ideadump.base.html.md): Errors and constants shared across ideadump.
- [ideadump.render](ideadump.render.html.md): Markdown views of the records: one &#96;README.md&#96; per idea and an index at the root.
- [ideadump.search](ideadump.search.html.md): Rank ideas against a query: BM25 over words, standard library only.
- [ideadump.store](ideadump.store.html.md): Where ideas live: a &#96;MutableMapping&#96; of &#96;/&#96;-separated path to text.
- [ideadump.tools](ideadump.tools.html.md): The verbs: plain functions, JSON-able arguments in, JSON-able dicts out.
